scope: Read-only independent review of the exact frozen ten-file stored-tree consumer; no tests, GUI, dependency preparation, Git, or source mutation by this reviewer.

resolved_findings.issue: Initial loader not canceled by the shared toolbar
resolved_findings.resolution: Dynamic Cancel load label and invocation-time p.loadTask guard call program.cancelLoad; ordinary Cancel work remains per-window. Actual primitive before-worker cancellation and already-published older loader tests are present.

resolved_findings.issue: Failed PrepareData admitted task callback could reuse the next numeric token and retire newer task/request
resolved_findings.resolution: Callback checks both captured numeric token and exact *tasks.Task identity before clearing any latest owner state. Failed preparation never installs its task. Original scenario red across batches1/7/64 and corrected repeated green recorded by producer.

observations: Stored source generation produces actual TreeNode labels, stable keys and parents; immutable TreeData owns detached storage. No procedural native domain substitute.

Task worker and reserved owner completion credits remain bounded and dual-terminal. Buffered request handoff occurs after admission; Prepare failure cancels the admitted worker without changing prior accepted request.
Latest callback retires its task before domain/model CAS. Accepted/error/cancel paths clear retained request; capacity/exhaustion Complete refusal keeps the exact recoverable request until Cancel.

Window lifetimes suppress closed-window publication; shared initial loader is application-scoped and checks each target lifetime before indexing. Independent surviving window remains a supported smoke assertion.
Apply filter acknowledges the real ordinary-field originating FIFO before capturing controlled filter text. Cancellation revokes settlement token/context and request authority.
Actual offscreen routing tests use measured IDs/incarnations, primitive events and explicit worker/owner quanta; smoke accurately describes owner-command geometry/settlement scope.
README separates logical stored/index bytes from process/native memory and does not claim frame performance, external AX, physical IME/VoiceOver, joined native/private-worker teardown or full P6.
limitations: Source review is not final formal qualifier, compiler/SDK closure, Cocoa or physical workflow acceptance. Producer qualification is being run separately.
Source/index logical memory caps exclude allocator and maps, previous borrowed snapshots, shaped text and process RSS.
This independent review does not re-audit the managed DataTree native runtime owned by the other reviewer.
